name: Illustration
summary: One spot-art set, called by name — 20 multi-colour illustrations imported from Figma, rendered by the shared <aha-illustration>, never inline SVG.
lead: ONE shared element — <aha-illustration name="empty-team"> — renders every multi-colour spot illustration from a single registry built from Figma (empty states, onboarding, plan tiers, mascots, offers). Agents call a name; they never hand-author or paste an <svg>. Unlike <aha-icon> (one-colour, currentColor), an illustration keeps its OWN palette; a single size edge scales it, preserving aspect ratio via the viewBox. Browse every name in the Illustration library.

opinion.note: Call by name from the registry — never inline an <svg>, never paste a raster PNG. An illustration is multi-colour art: it does NOT follow currentColor (that is <aha-icon>). Size it by a single edge; the aspect ratio is fixed by the source. If an illustration is genuinely missing, add the SVG under illustrations/svg and re-run build-illustrations.mjs. Raster-backed art (embedded bitmaps) is intentionally excluded — the library stays pure-SVG.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

codeNote: Same element + same registry → identical render in React and Vue. The geometry is imported from Figma and normalised (page-frame chrome stripped, clip-paths dropped, gradients kept, colours untouched) at build time by build-illustrations.mjs; the call site only names an illustration and a size.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element. Asserts the promises: the requested size becomes the rendered box for a square illustration (plan-pro 48×48 → 128→128px, 64→64px), an on-palette art colour renders untouched (a plan-pro path filled #A96FF0 renders rgb(169, 30... i.e. purple-40), NOT recoloured), and an unknown name paints the dashed error box in the --aha-color-error token.
